scientific.integrity: The motivating full PDF was inspected at the model equations, next-generation construction, strict-subthreshold global-stability theorem, and forward-bifurcation section; the model page was visually inspected. A primary HPV vaccination paper was checked for broader threshold coverage. The bundled symbolic checker independently verifies the critical left-null certificate and determinant identity. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The theorem closes the disease-free threshold for the deterministic six-compartment HPV model under its positive-rate assumptions. It does not classify supercritical global dynamics and does not assess the article's separate limit-cycle or optimal-control claims.

title: Critical HPV extinction holds at the closed reproduction threshold
